architecture_scope_line: Current public desktop scope covers Linux x64, macOS ARM64, and Windows x64 only. No public route is posted for Windows ARM64, Linux ARM64, and macOS x64 on the current shelf.
claim_boundary_line: Preview evidence and fallback routes can show real progress, but flagship wording is reserved for surfaces that independently clear the flagship acceptance bar.
desktop_pick_line: If you see both desktop apps, start with the Avalonia. Treat Blazor Desktop as a fallback path only when the download page or support explicitly tells you to use it.
fix_availability_summary: That warning will stay in place until the missing desktop installer proof is posted.
known_issue_summary: Proof freshness is missing or stale on this shelf, so preview publication is visible but not yet gold-ready.
missing_installer_lane_line: Still missing from the promoted installer lane: Windows.
proof_scope_line: Evidence on the public shelf is scoped to the posted files, named flows, and recent checks you can inspect today; downloads remain the primary route for trying Chummer.
quality_gap_line: Character math is already solid. The rough edges are mostly installer polish, update polish, and support polish.
release_verification_summary: Passed for installs and recovery, campaign session recovery, and support follow-up.
shelf_truth_line: Downloads are currently live for Linux and macOS, but Windows still lacks the promoted desktop installer proof this release says they need.
